title: Exact constant realization on derived module categories
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site with topology $J$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $R$ be a commutative ring. Write $\underline R$ for the constant ring sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Use module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and unbounded derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], with independently chosen localization morphism universes. The constant module functor $c_J:\operatorname{Mod}(R)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\underline R)$ of [def-sf-site-constant-module-functor], obtained by sheafifying the constant module presheaf, is additive and exact. Define the derived constant realization $\underline{(-)}:D(R)\to D(\mathcal C,\underline R)$ to be the functor induced by applying $c_J$ termwise to cochain complexes and descending at quasi-isomorphisms by the exact-functor localization construction. Thus its representative comparison is the canonical factorization $Q\circ C(c_J)\cong\underline{(-)}\circ Q$. No boundedness or finiteness is imposed on the complexes. The site object and morphism universes are independent and the coefficient universe contains both.

source.place: Paragraph immediately before Tag 09BD, lemma-map-out-of-locally-constant, defining the functor D(Lambda) to D(C,Lambda); exact module sheafification as in Sites Tag 00WJ and Modules on Sites Tag 03CY.

proof.text: The CommRingCat sheafification unit is locally injective and locally surjective. The RingCat unit obtained by forgetting commutativity has exactly the same underlying functions. Apply Mathlib Presheaf.equalizerSieve_mem and Presheaf.imageSieve_mem to those functions to prove realizationRingUnit_locallyBijective.

Evaluation of the constant module presheaf functor at each site object is the identity module functor. Apply PresheafOfModules.evaluationJointlyReflectsLimits and evaluationJointlyReflectsColimits to prove finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation. Module sheafification preserves finite limits by its Mathlib instance and colimits as a left adjoint. The composite preserves both, and leftExactFunctor_le_additiveFunctor supplies additivity. This proves commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor_exact without the separate exactness theorem for the RingCat presentation.

For every CommRingCat sheafification equivalence f, use GrothendieckTopology.W_iff_isLocallyBijective to obtain local injectivity and surjectivity. Forgetting commutativity changes neither equalizer nor image sieves, so the same local-bijectivity criterion applies in RingCat. This proves realization_forget_preservesSheafification and constructs realizationRingIso by constantCommuteCompose.

The constantCommuteCompose factorization identifies the two ring-sheafification units (realizationRingIso_fac). For a commuting triangle of locally bijective ring-presheaf maps, first construct the unit of module sheafification over the second coefficient sheaf as a linear map after restriction to the first coefficient sheaf (moduleSheafificationSeed). Apply the first module-sheafification adjunction to obtain moduleSheafificationComparison. Its underlying abelian-sheaf morphism is the identity, by toSheaf_map_sheafificationHomEquiv_symm and the abelian-sheafification adjunction. The forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, so this comparison is invertible; its naturality follows by faithfulness from identity maps. Apply this to realizationRingIso.inv and whisker with constant module presheaves to obtain commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor_transport. Finally apply the exact-functor mapDerivedCategory construction at independent localization sizes.

lean.statement: def commutativeSiteDerivedConstantModuleFunctor (R : Type (max u v)) [CommRing R] [HasDerivedCategory.{wR} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (realizationModules J R)] : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (realizationModules J R)
lean.note: Section 1(B): the recorded derived constant functor targets modules over constant RingCat sheafification; the recorded K-flat and tensor interfaces instead target modules over the forgotten constant CommRingCat sheaf. These presentations are canonically isomorphic but not definitionally equal. This module uses the same constant module presheaf and module sheafification with the commutative coefficient presentation, proves its exactness, and localizes it at independent derived-category sizes. realizationRingIso and commutativeSiteConstantModuleFunctor_transport explicitly identify it with the original recorded construction, which remains publicly imported.
